+    # Build adjacency lists once
+    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
+    for u, v, w in edges:
+        adj[u].append((v, w))
+        adj[v].append((u, w))
+
+    side = [-1] * n
+    cut_weight = 0
+
+    # Process nodes in random order to avoid bias
+    nodes = list(range(n))
+    random.shuffle(nodes)
+
+    for node in nodes:
+        # Calculate gain for placing node on side 0 or 1
+        gain0 = 0
+        gain1 = 0
+        for neighbor, w in adj[node]:
+            if side[neighbor] == 0:
+                gain1 += w
+            elif side[neighbor] == 1:
+                gain0 += w
+
+        # Choose side with higher gain
+        if gain1 > gain0:
+            side[node] = 1
+            cut_weight += gain1
+        else:
+            side[node] = 0
+            cut_weight += gain0
+
